messages:
deploybot: :warning: Deploy blocked: canary -> prod (region: us-west1). Commit: abc1234 (tag: v1.12.0-canary). CI gate failed (integration-tests). See CI: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/98234

jane (releases): ugh, which tests failed?

mike (eng-releases): quick summary from CI logs: several DB migration smoke tests + one flaky assertion in service-registry tests. Attaching failing lines:
```
FAIL tests/integration/test_migrations.py::test_migration_idempotency - AssertionError: expected 0 rows, got 1
FAIL tests/integration/test_service_registry.py::test_registry_restart - TimeoutError after 60s
```

sarah (infra): migration failure looks legit — new migration in this commit touches the stream_shard table. Not a rollback-only concern. Service-registry timeout smells like infra load spike, could be transient.

rui (qa): we've seen service-registry flake on canary before, but not the migration idempotency. Can we rerun CI first? If rerun passes we can proceed, else we need a plan.

jane (releases): timeline: this canary was scheduled to roll to prod in 30m. Options: 1) rerun CI now, 2) pin to previous stable tag (v1.11.9) for this window, 3) rollback if already partially rolled. Thoughts? @sarah @mike

mike (eng-releases): I can trigger a rerun now (low cost). If rerun fails, recommend pin to v1.11.9 for this release window and open a hotfix PR for the migration.

sarah (infra): pin sounds safest for the change window. If we pin, infra rollback isn't needed — just block the canary promotion. We should also add an automatic fallback policy in the deploy config.

rui (qa): agree. Also request: capture a minimized repro for the migration test so devs can iterate quickly.

jane (releases): @mike go ahead with rerun. If it fails, pin to v1.11.9 and I'll notify PMs and update release notes.

mike (eng-releases): rerun kicked off: https://ci.internal.redwood/run/98235 — ETA ~8m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

(8 minutes later)
deploybot: CI rerun completed: 98235 -> FAILED (same failing tests).

jane (releases): ok pining. @mike can you create the pin PR and update the deploytag?

mike (eng-releases): created PR #4102 to pin canary to v1.11.9 and updated deploy manifest. Also added fallback rule (canary -> previous) in case promotion fails. Link: https://git.internal.redwood/pulls/4102

sarah (infra): I applied a temporary hold on promotion in the console. Canary will not promote until manual unblock.

jane (releases): thanks. I'll post a short update on status page and mention impact in the release channel.

rui (qa): tracking ticket for migration investigation created: RD-5789. Tagging devs for follow-up.

mike (eng-releases): next steps: hotfix branch for migration idempotency check, add an extra integration assertion, and run extended premerge.

jane (releases): good. Marking this thread resolved for the deploy window — will reopen if any promotion attempts happen. :white_check_mark:
